name: percy-migration-skill
description: Migrate visual regression testing from BrowserStack Percy (web, Percy on Automate, App Percy, Storybook, static snapshots, uploads) to TestMu AI SmartUI in any language or framework: Playwright, Cypress, Selenium (JS, Python, Java, C#, Ruby), Puppeteer, WebdriverIO, TestCafe, Capybara, Appium, Storybook. Use whenever someone wants to move from Percy to SmartUI or LambdaTest, mentions @percy/cli, percy exec, percySnapshot, percyScreenshot, PERCY_TOKEN, .percy.yml, App Percy or Percy baselines, or asks for the SmartUI equivalent of a Percy command, option or SDK call.
